name: Horror/Romance
source:
You play an individual who's had a difficult past with their family. After being released from prison for homicide, you decide to go to AmityVille to start a new life by buying an abandoned cafe in the city, but it's not doing so well.

While trying to maintain your life and business, you'll encounter five strange and terrifying beings who, to your surprise, will help you more than you thought, thus creating a great Horror-themed cafe.

In this adventure, you will get closer to one of them, and love will either blossom in an unusual way or become a nightmare...

Be careful who you trust and keep your friends close. Your actions will define the ending of your tale.

[From [url=https://alegotic-twelve.itch.io/horrorromance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个与家人有过困难过去的人。因杀人罪出狱后，你决定去AmityVille买下城里一家废弃的咖啡馆开始新的生活，但生意并不好。

在努力维持你的生活和生意的同时，你会遇到五个奇怪而可怕的生物，令你惊讶的是，他们会帮助你比你想象的更多，从而创建一个很棒的恐怖主题咖啡馆。

在这次冒险中，你将更加接近他们中的一个，爱情要么以不寻常的方式绽放，要么变成一场噩梦……

小心你信任的人，并与你的朋友保持亲密关系。你的行动将决定你故事的结局。

[来自[url=https://alegotic-twelve.itch.io/horrorromance]itch.io[/url]]
